cases.description: Improve a small writing prompt without expanding it into a template-heavy mega-prompt.
cases.prompt: Use the prompt-enhancer skill. mode=concise prompt-only. Improve this prompt: `Write an email telling a customer their shipment is two days late. Be apologetic, do not promise a delivery date, and keep it under 120 words.`
manual_rubric: Preserves every constraint and does not add invented company, order, or delivery details.
Adds at most a useful audience/output clarification rather than ceremonial sections.
Returns only a directly usable prompt.

cases.description: Turn a vague coding request into an executable Pi task using active capabilities without hardcoding imaginary tools.
cases.prompt: Use the prompt-enhancer skill. target=pi mode=standard prompt-only. Improve this prompt for the current repository: `Fix the pagination issue and make sure it works.` Do not execute the resulting prompt.
manual_rubric: Adds a concrete investigation, implementation, and verification loop without assuming the bug's cause.
Uses Pi/repository capabilities semantically and does not paste skill instructions or invent unavailable integrations.
Defines completion while preserving the user's request to implement rather than only plan.

cases.description: Preserve legitimate related deliverables instead of collapsing them into one output.
cases.prompt: Use the prompt-enhancer skill. target=generic mode=standard prompt-only. Improve: `Analyze the attached parser logs, identify the root cause, propose a fix, write the patch, and update the troubleshooting docs. Do not change the public API.`
manual_rubric: Retains all related deliverables and orders them coherently.
Does not assume access to a repository or tools when target=generic.
Keeps the public API constraint prominent and adds no unrelated scope.
